name: Batman: Arkham Dual Pack
summary:
Batman: Arkham Dual Pack includes Batman: Arkham Asylum Game of the Year Edition and Batman: Arkham City Game of the Year Edition.

Batman: Arkham Asylum GOTY includes 4 extra Challenge Maps: Scarecrow Nightmare, Crime Alley, Totally Insane, and Nocturnal Hunter.

Batman: Arkham City GOTY includes :
- Harley Quinn's Revenge
- Catwoman Pack
- Robin Bundle Pack
- Nightwing Bundle Pack
- Arkham City Skins Pack
- Challenge Map Pack
